_about: Public-domain Henry Edward Manning (1808-1892, Archdeacon of Chichester, then Cardinal Archbishop of Westminster) for the Word Hoard: his four volumes of Anglican Sermons (1843-1850) from CCEL, and 30 more from Internet Archive scans, 1838-1892, among them The Unity of the Church (1842), The Grounds of Faith (1852), The Temporal Mission of the Holy Ghost (1865), The Internal Mission of the Holy Ghost (1875) and The Eternal Priesthood. From 1865 his title pages sign 'Henry Edward, Archbishop of Westminster' with no surname. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
_surname: henry edward, cardinal archbishop of westminster
